# Rippling

> > Rippling is a unified workforce management platform that combines HR, IT, payroll, and spend management for modern businesses.

Founded by Parker Conrad and headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Bengaluru, Rippling serves companies ranging from AI startups to global enterprises. The platform integrates HRIS, compliance automation, employee scheduling, IT management, and financial tools to streamline operations across the entire employee lifecycle.

## Key Topics

- Workforce Management
- HR Compliance & Automation
- Employee Onboarding
- HRIS Platforms (BambooHR, UKG, Dayforce)
- Payroll & Benefits Administration
- IT & Access Management
- Spend Management
- Employee Scheduling Software
- Remote Work & Distributed Teams
- Canada & International Markets
- Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
- ACA & Tax Compliance
- Compensation Planning
- Partner Ecosystem (Brokers, CPAs, Accountants)
- API Performance & Technical Infrastructure
